model: OJ Air Plus AHU controller (EXcon-Plus), SW 1.09
applies_to: OJ Electronics OJ Air Plus air handling unit controllers (device name EXcon-Plus) with software 1.09.
summary: The OJ Air Plus is an air handling unit controller with a native BACnet server. Its EDE file lists close to a thousand objects: Analog Inputs for measured temperatures, pressures, flows and outputs; Analog Values for setpoints and configuration; Binary Inputs for status and alarm flags; Binary Values for function switches and BMS commands. Many objects only matter when the matching function or module is fitted.
notes: Built from the EDE export (B.I.G.-EU layout 2.3, 19/02/2026). The EDE has no read/write column, so access is inferred: AV/BV writable, AI/BI read-only.
Object names are the controller's long texts, cut off at about 63 characters as in the EDE; the description holds the short internal tag.
Many values are scaled: names marked [1/100C] or [1/100%] carry hundredths (2150 = 21.50).
Units come from the EDE unit codes; a few names state a different unit in brackets (for example power named [kW] with the code for watts).
Four object names contain a semicolon in the EDE (BI 173, 283, 284, 297); they are kept whole.
The EDE does not say which BACnet transport the controller uses; check it on site.

integration.summary: Read the unit state from AI 0 and BI 0, the temperatures and flows from the AI block, and the two alarm relays (BI 30 A-alarm, BI 31 B-alarm). BMS run modes go through AV 108, which only works after the physical operation input is activated; BV 0 resets alarms.

setup: The EDE gives device instance 15530 and device name EXcon-Plus.
gotchas: Most temperatures and percentages are in hundredths.
Object names are long texts cut at about 63 characters; map by type and instance, not by name.
Outdoor and room temperature from the BMS (AV 102, AV 103) are only used when BV 15 / BV 16 activate them.
